player_prompt.intro:
Nge ujile Mubadi {player_id} mu **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tuma kubadiaku kama **[macro  micro]** (nomero zole 0-8):
• *macro*  = ku kubadi nini mini-tabuleiro ujile
• *micro* = ku kubadi nini quadradu ndani ya mini-tabuleiro
Exemplo `[7 8]` ➜ bota simboloaku mu mini-tabuleiro 7, quadradu 8, e
força oponenteaku kubadilaku mu mini-tabuleiro 8 kubwamu.

Nge ujile `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O kijimbuete kia tokala ku i soneka mu mukanda iú, o [macro micro].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kala dijimbuluilu dia tokala di kala ni 0 mba 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: O kijimbuete kia "micro_board", mba mbandu ia muxi, iala ku thandu dia kaxa.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: O inzo íii io lange kiá.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: O muthu ua tokala ku ta o kidimbu kiê, mu papela ia mukuá iala ni kolo imoxi.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: O kitutu kia te kiá, ki tu kuatekesa.

next_board.any: kima kioso-kioso kia difu ni kalatá ka zele

game_action.played: Mubadi {player_id} kubadilaku mu mini-tabuleiro {macro_idx}, kasadu {micro_idx} (linha {row}, koluna {col}). Mubadi {opponent_id} kufwete kubadilaku mu {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: O mukua jisanzala {player_id} u nganhala o "Final Tic Tac Toe!" (O Finale de Tick-Tac-Toes!)
